name: Group Policy
short_description: A Windows feature that lets administrators define settings once in group policy objects (GPOs) and have domain-joined Windows computers and users apply them automatically through Active Directory.

evidence.quote: What group policy actually does somewhere in your company? Right now, a rule is telling a computer what to do. You
sign users in with Kerberos and apply group policy. Most people assume Entra ID replaces every active directory
